records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $115.1 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to $95.7 million in the three months ended March 31, 2024, an increase of $19.4 million, or 20.3%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 is a result of improved snowfall in our core markets leading to higher volumes in 2025, as well as strong municipal volumes.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales at our Work Truck Attachments segment were $36.5 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to $23.8 million in the three months ended March 31, 2024, an increase of $12.7 million.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the three months ended March 31, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 was a result of improved municipal volumes and price increase realization.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $20.3 million from the three months ended March 31, 2024 to the three months ended March 31, 2025.
